issues: Rhinoplasty section: it says the angle "can change with surgery" and describes how the angle shifts by sex before saying the surgery isn't recommended. That reads as neutral planning information. It also ends with "talk to a qualified professional before considering this", which presents surgery as a possible next step.

Indian clinical study / differences section: the table calls the sample 30 people with 116.7° overall, but the cited evidence also reports female mean 126.08° versus male 110.43°. The draft omits this and says women measured more obtuse only in the Turkish study, so "again" is supported, but the sample size of 30 is unsupported by the evidence.
